Prep time: 15 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 15 minutes Number of Servings: 8 Ingredients 1 Tablespoon lime juice 1/4 cup fresh mint leaves 2 Tablespoons packed brown sugar 3 cups watermelon cubes 3 cups honeydew cubes Directions Blend lime juice, mint leaves and brown sugar together in a small food processor. Place melon cubes in a bowl. Drizzle dressing over melon and toss gently. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Try with other types of melon such as cantaloupe or crenshaw. Try omitting the brown sugar and adding crumbled feta cheese.
